scriptData.label: @effect.name
Broken Head (Major)

description.label: Description
description.value:
Hungry for gore, your foe tears out a good piece of your throat! Apart from a torn carotid artery, your vocal apparatus is also mangled.

Effects: Gain @Condition[Bleeding] (4). Should you survive, you’ll also suffer the effects of a Broken Bone (Major), except you fail all rolls for long-term effects automatically.
